instruction.text: Read the chapter, then answer the questions.

atoms.text: The last few months were especially hard work for Knut’s family as the annual Trollaland Bulked Bridge Contest was approaching. Every Bridge Troll in the city participated — it was absolutely not to be missed. Each of the 21 Bridge Troll families and their respective bridges participate to see which bridge is truly the best. There are three categories: most beautiful bridge, best balanced bridge (in which coins are rolled across the surface) and of course, the best bulked bridge category (in which weight is gradually added until one last bridge is standing).

This was always a tricky time of year because after the contest all the bridges (except the winning bridge) were broken for several weeks while repairs were made. This was, however, very good for the winning bridge who then charged even higher rates for passing. This was considered one of the rewards of winning. There was one extremely tricky year in which the last two standing bridges fell at the same time and Trollaland had no bridges in or out of the city. Nobody could leave the city until at least one bridge had been repaired. We don’t speak of that year.

Knut thought it was a bit strange that all the bridges were destroyed except for the winning bridge. It was always a terrible time of year for buying food in the other cities as the traffic was really terrible. Knut asked his parents once why they couldn’t change the contest so that all the bridges were still standing afterwards. It would make it so much easier for the following year’s competition if they could at least begin with a functioning bridge. His parents always answered: “This is the way we bridge trolls do it. It’s tradition!” Knut had to simply accept that.

The most important contest was the final one, the best bulked bridge. Everyone wanted to win, and the other prizes were merely consolations. Knut and his family had been getting second place to the McTroll family in this contest since Knut could remember. But his mother’s strict routine and daily checks were going to change all that. They were going to break the McTroll family streak and take home the trophy at last.

atoms.a: Which of these are names of the three competitions?

hint.text: There is more than one correct answer.

b: ++All the bridges except for the winning bridge are destroyed.
Everyone is sad after they lose the contest.
There are so many bridge briars loose in the city.
